messages:
OpsBot: :rotating_light: ALERT: p99 latency SLO breach on shared-gpu-pool-3 detected — service=redwood-inference-api region=us-west-2 p99=18.2s p95=1.2s. Paging oncall.
Eve (Oncall): I'm on it. Paging SRE. Any impact to streaming sessions?
Sam (SRE): yup, we see streaming stalls — connection keepalive spikes and partial frames dropped. hitting 40% streaming stall rate. looks like multi-tenant IO contention on node-42.
Mei (Infra): adding logs: dmesg shows repeated block layer throttles, and cgroup write_bps clamped. suspect noisy tenant doing large checkpoint writes to NVMe.
Eve (Oncall): can someone grab top and iostat from node-42?
Sam (SRE): running quick probes...
Sam (SRE): ```ssh node-42 'iostat -x 1 3; nvidia-smi dmon -s u'```
Sam (SRE): iostat shows ~90% util on nvme0n1, avg await 120ms. nvidia-smi shows GPU mem healthy but compute queue backed up on one tenant's containers.
Miguel (DevEx): which tenant? need customer-impact mapping if we tell support.
Sam (SRE): tenant: org-78 (app-mltrain) - heavy checkpointing to /mnt/checkpoints inside container. They share the same host pool.
Lia (Support): lia_support here — which accounts hit p99? we need a list to notify customers and CS.
Eve (Oncall): affected tenants: org-78, org-21 (inference batch), org-99 (short-lived bursts). Handoff to Lia to draft customer note after we estabilize.
Mei (Infra): quick mitigation options: 1) throttle container IO via cgroup blkio.weight change 2) migrate noisy pods to quarantine-pool3 3) temporarily mark node-42 unschedulable and shift new traffic
Sam (SRE): trying soft throttle first. Command:
Sam (SRE): ```echo 100 > /sys/fs/cgroup/blkio/docker/$CONTAINER_ID/blkio.weight```
Sam (SRE): applied to org-78 heavy pod -> observe.
Sam (SRE): p95 down to 700ms, p99 down to 9.1s — improvement but still above SLO.
Mei (Infra): proceed with migration: cordon node-42 and migrate org-78 pods to isolation-pool
Mei (Infra): ```kubectl cordon node-42 && kubectl drain node-42 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --force``` 
Miguel (DevEx): can we route new streaming sessions away from shared-gpu-pool-3 via routing policy? fallback to dedicated-small while we rebalance.
Eve (Oncall): flipping routing rule to prefer dedicated-small for streaming for 10m window...
Eve (Oncall): routing change applied. monitoring.
Sam (SRE): after migration and routing change: p95=210ms, p99=1.05s, streaming stalls down to 3.2%.
Lia (Support): thanks — starting customer outreach: draft status for org-78 and org-21: "We experienced elevated latency due to storage contention on a shared GPU host; mitigation underway; no data loss. We'll follow up with RCA." Sending now.
Miguel (DevEx): note: need an automated admission control to detect heavy checkpointing patterns and quarantine. ticket coming.
Mei (Infra): created temporary node taint: ```kubectl taint nodes quarantine-pool key=noisy:NoSchedule``` to isolate migrating workloads.
Eve (Oncall): summary for incident channel: initial cause = NVMe IO saturation from checkpointing in multi-tenant host. Primary mitigations = cgroup IO throttle, pod migration, routing fallback. Impact = p99 spike to 18s, affected customers org-78/org-21/org-99, streaming stalls spike to 40%. Resolution = p99 reduced to ~1s after mitigations. Next steps: full postmortem, long-term admission control, telemetry alert for blkio await > 50ms.
Sam (SRE): logging timeline and metrics to incident tracker.
Miguel (DevEx): I'll open dev ticket for admission control + UX for per-tenant checkpoint policies.
Lia (Support): CS will follow up with org-78 and org-21 for impact assessment and any SLA credits.
Eve (Oncall): handing off to night oncall @Sam (SRE) for follow-up and postmortem. tagging the incident: sev=3 noisy-neighbor-io
Sam (SRE): ack. I'll own postmortem and include mitigation scripts. will update incident board in 1h.
OpsBot: Incident closed by Eve (Oncall) — status: mitigated, severity: S3, duration: 18m. Runbooks: noisy-neighbor -> quarantine + cgroup-throttle.
Eve (Oncall): good job team :thumbsup: Please add notes about customer communication and any follow-up tasks.
